text: Photosynthesis converts light energy into chemical energy: chlorophyll in the chloroplasts absorbs sunlight, which drives the reactions that build glucose from carbon dioxide and water, releasing oxygen.
Newton's second law of motion states that the net force on an object equals its mass times its acceleration, so a heavier object needs a larger force to reach the same acceleration.

Differentiation gives the instantaneous rate of change of a function, and integration reverses it to recover the accumulated area under the curve; together they are tied by the fundamental theorem of calculus.
To fold a fitted bedsheet, tuck each corner into the next, smooth out the elastic edge, and fold the resulting rectangle into thirds before stacking it in the closet.
During mitosis, a single cell duplicates its chromosomes and then divides once to produce two genetically identical daughter cells, each with the same chromosome number as the parent.
Meiosis produces four genetically distinct gametes, each with half the chromosome number of the parent cell, through two successive divisions following one round of DNA replication.
Ohm's law states that the current through a conductor is directly proportional to the voltage across it and inversely proportional to its resistance, expressed as V = IR.
To solve the circuit, apply Kirchhoff's voltage law to sum the voltage drops around the loop to zero, then use Ohm's law to convert each drop into a current through the known resistance.
The French Revolution began in 1789 when financial crisis and widespread food shortages led the Third Estate to storm the Bastille, toppling the absolute monarchy of Louis XVI.

The Industrial Revolution transformed manufacturing through steam power and mechanized textile mills, shifting economies from agrarian to factory-based production across Britain and beyond, decades before upheavals like the French Revolution reshaped politics on the continent.
The Pythagorean theorem states that in a right triangle, the square of the hypotenuse equals the sum of the squares of the other two sides, written as a squared plus b squared equals c squared.

The law of cosines generalizes the Pythagorean theorem to triangles that are not right triangles, but this passage focuses only on how to compute a side length from the other two sides and their included angle.
Binary search repeatedly halves a sorted array, comparing the target to the middle element and discarding the half that cannot contain it, achieving logarithmic time complexity.
Merge sort recursively splits the array in half, sorts each half, and merges the sorted halves back together, giving it a time complexity of O(n log n) in every case.
Preheat the oven to 350 degrees, cream the butter and sugar until fluffy, then fold in the flour and chocolate chips before baking the cookies for twelve minutes.
A covalent bond forms when two atoms share one or more pairs of electrons, allowing each atom to attain a more stable electron configuration, as seen in the H2 molecule.

Ionic bonding occurs when one atom transfers electrons to another, creating oppositely charged ions that attract each other electrostatically — a contrast to covalent bonding, where electrons are shared rather than transferred.
The law of supply and demand describes how the price of a good rises when demand exceeds supply and falls when supply exceeds demand, converging toward an equilibrium price.
Opportunity cost is the value of the next-best alternative given up when choosing one option over another, such as the wages foregone by attending college full time.
The Roman Empire began in 27 BC when Augustus became the first emperor, ending the centuries-old Roman Republic in which power had been shared among elected senators and consuls.
Plate tectonics explains how the Earth's lithosphere is divided into rigid plates that move slowly over the mantle, driving earthquakes, volcanic activity, and the formation of mountain ranges.
The rock cycle describes how igneous rock can weather into sediment through erosion, be compacted into sedimentary rock, and later transform into metamorphic rock under heat and pressure.

The quadratic formula gives the roots of any equation in the form ax squared plus bx plus c equals zero as x equals negative b plus or minus the square root of b squared minus four a c, all over two a.
Completing the square rewrites a quadratic expression as a perfect square plus a constant, a technique that can also be used to derive the quadratic formula itself.
A hash table stores key-value pairs by computing a hash of the key to determine an index into an underlying array, giving average constant-time lookups, insertions, and deletions.
The sonnet's volta, or turn, typically arrives in the final couplet, shifting the poem's argument or emotional register after the octave has established its central tension.
World War II began in Europe in 1939 when Germany invaded Poland, drawing Britain and France into a conflict that eventually spanned nearly every continent and ended in 1945.
The Cold War was a decades-long standoff between the United States and the Soviet Union that emerged from the alliances and power vacuums left in the aftermath of the Second World War.
An acid is a substance that donates hydrogen ions in solution, lowering the pH, while a base accepts hydrogen ions or donates hydroxide ions, raising the pH toward the basic end of the scale.
In this redox reaction, zinc loses two electrons to become Zn2+ while copper gains them; balancing the equation stoichiometrically shows one mole of zinc reacts with exactly one mole of copper ions.
The probability of two independent events both occurring is the product of their individual probabilities, so flipping two fair coins and getting heads on both has a probability of one-quarter.

Combinatorics counts the number of ways to choose or arrange objects — a foundational tool for computing probabilities later on — such as figuring out how many five-card hands can be dealt from a standard deck using the combination formula.
To tune a guitar to standard tuning, adjust each string until it matches E, A, D, G, B, and E from lowest to highest, using an electronic tuner or matching harmonics between adjacent strings.
A pre-run warm-up should include dynamic stretches like leg swings and walking lunges for about five minutes to raise muscle temperature and reduce injury risk before sprinting.
Wet-on-wet watercolor technique involves applying pigment to paper that is already damp, letting colors bleed and blend softly, which works well for skies and soft background washes.
